items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: her name is Anne Reid Maxwell, after my grandmother, Anne Reid, my mother's mother.

ctx.x: Well, his name was Reid (PHONETIC), too. See, my grandfather's name was Gilmore Reid and I'm trying to think of my great grandfather's first name. I really can't think of it at the moment. And they came from -- my mother's side, this was my grandfather Reid, great grandfather Reid was Scotch Irish and his wife was, I believe, German Jewish. And on my mother's mother's side her father was Scotch Irish, he was from New Orleans and he was an artist there and when the Civil War started he went up to New York to join…
